reason: The cited evidence shows that cryo-rolling and annealing creates heterogeneous microstructures and enhances strength-ductility synergy in specific high-entropy alloys (E1, E2, E3), but none of the evidence involves the (MnNiSi)0.62(FeCoGe)0.38 alloy or measures caloric properties, leaving the crucial premise that caloric response is preserved entirely unsupported.
premises: Cryogenic rolling followed by annealing can create a refined, heterogeneous lamellar microstructure in high-entropy alloys.
Such a heterogeneous microstructure enhances strength and ductility simultaneously.
The enhanced mechanical properties are due to grain-boundary strengthening and hierarchical constraint effects.
The phase transformation characteristics and caloric response are preserved because the chemical composition and transformation mechanism remain unaltered.
The processing route is applicable to brittle intermetallic-containing alloys to improve mechanical integrity.
